notes: 历史CSV与当时输入/程序身份缺失；未把review bundle之外的withheld.csv当受检代理可用证据。
Both configurations identified the missing final record in all 3 coverage trials. The single old-Skill run also did so; it is retained separately, not pooled.
Each configuration had 4/5 fully passing records. Both coverage trial 2 runs omitted the existing-output rejection probe; the Skill run disclosed UNVERIFIED, the baseline omitted that remaining gap.
The current Skill was actually read in 4/5 installed runs. The historical-review run only listed its path, so that outcome does not demonstrate Skill invocation.
There are 3 coverage trials but only 1 plan and 1 history trial per configuration. An aggregate over this uneven, tiny matrix is descriptive, not a reliability or superiority estimate.
The same current host defaults/tools and input bytes were used, but inherited global configuration was not isolated; trials overlapped in time. Wall time and tokens do not establish human savings.
All retained source/artifact hashes agree. The harness excludes .git and __pycache__; no absolute zero-write or zero-external-state claim is made.
Claude Code paired attempts failed with authentication 403 before task tool execution. They are environmental gaps, excluded from business scores, not model failures or successful second-host runs.
Independent grading and supplied manifests support local record consistency, not authenticity of all collection or production readiness.
